title: Battle of Sultanpet Tope
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sultanpet Tope", at revision 1370590107, opens: "The Battle of Sultanpet Tope was a small action fought on 5 and 6 April 1799 between forces of the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Mysore during the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War. Although initially checked, it was a British victory." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4872458, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1799 fight between British East India company & the kingdom of mysore". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
